text: Sorry for the late message, I've been on since 6am and my brain is mush. I'm minding a little girl overnight, she's 2, and her temp is 38.6. She threw up once around 9 but she's had her water and some milk since and it's all stayed down. Mum's on a night shift and I can't reach her. One thing that gave me a fright: she's got purple all round her mouth. I panicked for a second, then remembered she had a big bowl of blueberries and some blackcurrant squash at teatime. It wipes off on a wet cloth, it's just juice. Do I just keep an eye on her or does she need to be seen
